title: Hruday exact finite-graph first- and second-order Wilson coefficients on the two-plaquette graph (a different finite model)
accepted: On the Round11 two-plaquette graph (open two-square patch: 6 vertices, 7 links, 6 Gauss constraints; gauge-invariant sector), for the finite-graph model H_FG = K - tau_FG (W_1 + W_2) in alpha units (= Round11 H(alpha=1, lambda1=lambda2=tau_FG, rho=1) - 2 tau_FG), both faces of the Round11 two-plaquette graph coupled equally, K the sum of the seven link Casimirs (rho=1), I1.5 sign, gauge-invariant sector, with observable <W_1> = <psi_0,(1/2)Tr(U) psi_0>, U = vM h3^-1 vL^-1 h1, and cutoffs D in {6,8} (trace-monomial basis of total degree D, dimensions 84 and 165): (1) d<W_1>/dtau_FG at tau_FG=0 is exactly 1/6 at D=6 and at D=8 (enclosure [1/6,1/6]; also on the untruncated graph, psi_1=(W_1+W_2)/3 exactly), and the own free reference computed in the same code path is <W_1>(0)=0 exactly; (2) at tau_FG in {+-1/1000, +-1/100, +-1/10} the full-graph <W_1> lies in the exported exact enclosures (listed in admitted_values.enclosures; e.g. D=8, tau_FG=+1/10: [8330560043705980737198104247838582935020907/500000000000000000000000000000000000000000000, 16661120087411961480213908206571701630183797/1000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000], about 0.016661120087411961474 to 0.016661120087411961480), each excluding 0 with the sign of tau_FG, the D=8 enclosure inside the D=6 one, the -tau_FG enclosure the exact negation; (3) the second-order coefficient of <W_1> is exactly 0 (shared-link centre flip), the second-order energy coefficient is -1/6, <W_1> = tau_FG/6 - (187/33696) tau_FG^3 + (767713/2523156480) tau_FG^5 + ..., E_0 = -tau_FG^2/6 + (187/67392) tau_FG^4 + ..., second-order <W_1^2>, <W_1 W_2>, <z> equal 7/576, 79/2808, 7/216, all finite-model values from exact Rayleigh-Schroedinger algebra with zero truncation error at both cutoffs, never fitted; (4) the complete residual lies in the first omitted shell and is itemized in five parts at every point: (a) seven per-link rows (thresholds 123/2 and 96 on h1,vL,h3 and h2,vR,h4; 45 and 69 on vM), (b) the joint product channel (threshold 48 and 145/2, with corner overlaps and the positive x-y interference), (c) gauge projection exactly 0 with its reason, (d) the Ritz residual with Davis-Kahan and Eckart angles and the Weyl separation 3-2|tau_FG|, (e) directed arithmetic; tail_lower is 45 (D=6) and 69 (D=8). The finite-graph derivative of <W>_FG at tau_FG=0, under the stated normalization dictionary, is consistent with the matched Z^3 first-order coefficient 1/144; this is a consistency check on a different, finite model, not a prediction, not a confirmation of the Z^3 value, and it does not transfer to any subsequential limit of the AQ construction or resolve roadmap goal 2. The finite graph is consistent with the matched coefficient and nothing more; its one-face variant (second face uncoupled), which the contract text also admits, is a different finite model that differs at third order.
limitations: Only the Round11 two-square patch and the named two-face model (both faces coupled equally, alpha=rho=1), D in {6,8} and the declared grid; a static ground-state mean with no dynamics, correlator, clock or mass-gap reading

No statement about the AQ model, its subsequential limits, K_2 or the Z^3 shift; roadmap goal 2 is not resolved; no continuum or weak-coupling claim; the zero second-order coefficient is a finite-graph centre-flip fact
The dictionary 1/6 <-> 1/144 is a consistency check expected from the shared normalization (energy 3, E[W^2]=1/4); not a prediction and not a confirmation of the Z^3 value
The one-face model is not admitted; its values are the skeptic alternative reading, with the certified second-square shift tau^3/4212 + O(tau^5) between the two

model: FG(two-plaquette graph of Round11: two adjacent squares sharing one link, seven links, six Gauss constraints, gauge-invariant trace-monomial basis of polynomial degree D in {6,8}, dimensions 84 and 165; H_FG = K - tau_FG (W_1 + W_2) in alpha units with BOTH faces coupled equally (Round11 H(alpha=1, lambda_1=lambda_2=tau_FG, rho=1) minus 2 tau_FG); I1.5 sign convention; tau_FG in {+-1/1000, +-1/100, +-1/10}; observable <W_1> of one square); model_is_finite_graph true, transfers_to_aq false; single forward producer with the skeptic's pre-comparison replay from the contract alone and post-comparison review
decision: Admit, for the two-face finite model named above (the contract fixed neither the one-face nor the two-face coupling; the producer disclosed its model in the verdict, report and results; the skeptic's one-face pre-comparison reading remains admissible and its values are recorded as the other model): (1) the derivative of <W_1> at tau_FG=0 is exactly [1/6, 1/6] at D=6 and D=8 with tail term exactly 0 (the first-order vector (W_1+W_2)/3 is exact in the full space), and the graph's own free reference is exactly 0 in the same code path; under the normalization dictionary tau_FG = tau/24 the value 1/6 corresponds to the matched Z^3 coefficient 1/144: a consistency check on a different finite model, never a prediction, confirmation or transfer; (2) exact enclosures of <W_1> at all twelve grid points and both cutoffs (half-widths 1.1e-29, 1.1e-22, 1.14e-15 at D=6 and 2.8e-39, 2.8e-30, 2.9e-21 at D=8; every D=8 enclosure inside its D=6 enclosure; the -tau values exact negatives; all twelve exclude the free reference, hence sign_certified_finite_graph), certified by the exact full-space residual on the first omitted shell (36/55 orthogonal sectors), the certified gap E_1 >= 3 - 2|tau|, Temple's bound with the Round11 tail comparison (tail_lower 45 at D=6, 69 at D=8) and an Eckart angle bound; (3) the second-order coefficient of <W_1> is exactly 0 (shared-link flip) with E_0's -1/6, <W_1^2> 7/576, <W_1 W_2> 79/2808, a_3 = -187/33696 and a_5 = 767713/2523156480, identical at both cutoffs with truncation error exactly 0; the one-face model differs certifiably by tau^3/4212 + O(tau^5) (a_3 = -5/864, E_2 = -1/12), and only the one-face model coincides with AW1's one-plaquette fixture; (4) the five-part residual ledger: (a) per-link tails with thresholds 123/2 -> 96 (non-shared links) and 45 -> 69 (shared link vM), (b) the joint product channel with thresholds 48 and 145/2 (the two face channels interfere and are not added in quadrature), (c) gauge projection exactly 0 with a rational-quaternion fixture, (d) the Ritz residual with Davis-Kahan and Eckart angles, (e) directed arithmetic; the python-flint Arb preview is labelled preview only, never imported by check.py, and its balls lie inside the exact enclosures. Bind the producer's exact rationals; the skeptic's independent two-face degree-12 enclosures contain them and its one-face enclosures are disjoint (different model).
